classification: Root independent scope decision; original frozen nine probes and primary grades unchanged
required_followup: Chunk-neutral replay and body-consumption disconnect diagnostics applied to all six terminal candidates and the original reference; base feature availability separately recorded.
root_decision: The middleware contract requires replaying accepted bytes and delegating subsequent receives after replay. It does not require one coalesced ASGI message. Request.body must preserve ClientDisconnect; the middleware contract does not forbid calling a downstream app that may consume a captured disconnect. The two trial18 original supplemental failures therefore reflect unsupported oracle assumptions, not demonstrated candidate defects.

unsupported_assumptions.test_middleware_partial_disconnect_prese: Assumes the middleware itself raises ClientDisconnect before downstream invocation even when downstream does not consume the body.
unsupported_assumptions.test_middleware_zero_empty_replay_then_e: Assumes accepted empty chunks are coalesced into a single final http.request frame.
